items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Week 7; will test pregame per McVay. Took majority of Thursday practice but lacked full explosion/power.
items.why: Calf injury felt during practice; pregame test planned.
items.implication: If OUT, massive TE funnel and secondary WR upside in Rams offense with Adams also OUT.
items.opportunity: Higbee/Parkinson/Atwell hierarchy; elevated TE target share historically when Puka out.

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (high ankle sprain) vs Bengals; said 'heading in the right direction' after Friday work.
items.why: High ankle sprain; limited/practice participation and optimistic comments.
items.implication: Game-time decision critical for Ravens offense and DFS slate; if OUT, major downgrade to skill players.
items.opportunity: Monitor early news; backups and Ravens pass catchers swing heavily.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) after limited return to practice; key for Jets vs MIA.
items.implication: If ACTIVE, immediate RB1 upside in favorable matchup.
items.opportunity: Full workload expected if cleared; handcuff monitoring otherwise.

items.text: Official OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson.
items.implication: Creates clear role expansions and handcuff/backup opportunities across multiple teams.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries in SF (Kittle/CMC), LAR TEs, ATL Bijan, etc.

items.text: Mike Evans (Achilles) OUT vs Falcons confirmed by Shanahan; Deebo also OUT.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; massive funnel to Kittle and possible CMC slot work.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets spike; CMC more receiving opportunity.

items.text: Tempted by CMC lining up more in slot amid 49ers WR injuries (despite usual skepticism of RB-as-WR talk); Kaelon Black presence noted. CMC smiled at question.
items.why: Dire WR situation; coach/player comments; rare buy-in.
items.implication: Potential receiving boost on top of elite RB role.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to return Week 7 vs DAL; if active, goes right back into fantasy lineups (agrees with Stephania Bell).
If Breece Hall plays vs MIA, starts immediately in lineups despite some injury caution from others.
If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell etc. With Adams already OUT.
items.why: Calf issue; McVay pregame test quotes; historical TE share when Puka out.
items.implication: TE1 streaming and secondary WRs become viable if OUT.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Rams TEs; 37% TE share prior Puka absences.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since return.
items.why: Usage spike post-Caleb return; Kmet IR further helps.
items.opportunity: High target share, routes in Bears offense.

items.text: Bijan Robinson full opportunity vs SF DvP (inflates opposing RBs +4.4%, 7th most) with Brian Robinson OUT. Recent SF RB catches high.
items.why: BRob OUT; SF conceding RB production; Bijan usage data.
items.implication: RB1 ceiling game; start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/target share expected; no committee threat.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: awesome scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Ignore 'National TE Day' narrative.
items.why: WR outs create target vacuum; scheme elite for TE.
items.implication: TE1 smash spot; high target/route share.
items.opportunity: Funnel routes, red-zone, two-minute; CMC may add slot but Kittle primary.

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes; Kmet IR (season-ending knee) reduces 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet to IR confirmed; Burden efficiency data.
items.implication: Increased route share and WR upside with Caleb.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/route rate; YPRR projects well.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% snaps last three weeks; concerning usage despite talent.
items.why: Snap share data over recent weeks.
items.implication: Hard to trust as more than depth/handcuff until role expands.
